'''Sakifwanna''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="LoNH" /> that was located within the [[Sakifwanna system/Legends|Sakifwanna system]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The planet lay on the [[Elgit–M'Hanna Corridor]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that connected it to the worlds of [[Elgit]] and [[M'Hanna]].<ref name="LoNH" /> A smaller [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route linked Sakifwanna to the [[Cyax system/Legends|Cyax system]],<ref name="TEA" /> and another hyperlane connected the world to the planet of [[Sakiya|Saki]].<ref name="LoNH" />

Sakifwanna, the name of which meant "Fourth Saki"<ref name="LoNH" /> and was shared with "fwanna," the [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] word for "four,"<ref name="Phrasebook">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref> was a [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] world of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] species that was native to Saki. Sakifwanna served as a nursery world for the [[Sakiyan Collective]], with Sakiyan shepherds [[Reproduction/Legends|breeding]] creatures for the repopulation of Saki's game preserves.<ref name="LoNH" /> The fate of Sakifwanna following the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of the Hutt Space by the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was unclear to the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sakifwanna was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square T-11.<ref name="TEA" />
